# Third-Party Libraries

This directory contains third-party libraries bundled with Burner.

## nlohmann/json

- **File**: `json.hpp`
- **Version**: Latest (single-header)
- **License**: MIT (see `LICENSE.nlohmann_json`)
- **Website**: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
- **Purpose**: JSON parsing for MusicBrainz API responses

To update, download the latest single-header version:
```bash
curl -sL https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/latest/download/json.hpp -o json.hpp
```
